create_secret_sync: create a secret with a name, value, and optional tags using the sync create_secret method
create_secret_async: create a secret asynchronously with a name, value, and optional tags using create_secret_async
get_secret_sync: get a secret by its ID and return a StringSecret using the sync get_secret method
get_secret_async: get a secret asynchronously by its ID and return a StringSecret using get_secret_async
delete_secret_sync: delete a secret by its ID using the sync delete_secret method
